notes: No look-alikes: nine distinct dominant colours. Closest pairs, still separable at every yaw: bfrzvk (silver-to-navy gradient, black base) vs lugwcz (solid mottled navy, grey base); opivig (small 11 cm cola, white swirl and black panel) vs wbrrad (plain red, 15 cm); evcxlr (peach-tan) vs xmjfcg (mustard with white patches). itolcg and wbrrad are plain single-colour cans.
